local me = Game.GetLocalPlayer()
local pReligion = Players[me]:GetReligion()
if pReligion:GetPantheon() >= 0 then print("ERR:ALREADY_HAS_PANTHEON|You already have a pantheon"); print("---END---"); return end
local belief = GameInfo.Beliefs["BELIEF_DANCE_OF_THE_AURORA"]
if belief == nil then print("ERR:BELIEF_NOT_FOUND|BELIEF_DANCE_OF_THE_AURORA"); print("---END---"); return end
local params = {}
params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_BELIEF_TYPE] = belief.Hash
UI.RequestPlayerOperation(me, PlayerOperations.FOUND_PANTHEON, params)
print("OK:PANTHEON_FOUNDED|" .. Locale.Lookup(belief.Name))
print("---END---")
